shortDescription: Oil extended gains as traders awaited details of an Iranian deal with Oman to manage shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, according to Bloomberg.Bloomberg's Michael Heath said the agreement is close, but gave no further details.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Oil Extends Gains as Iran Says Oman Deal Is Near
